form_factor_matrix — OPTICS radiosity op

• 資料種類:table → matrix

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.form_factor_matrix(patches, n_quad=3, symmetric=True, far_ratio=8.0, memory_budget_mb=256.0)(要直接呼叫實作,import radiosity3d; radiosity3d.form_factor_matrix(patches, n_quad=3, symmetric=True, far_ratio=8.0, memory_budget_mb=256.0);從台帳取用則 opsoptics.get("form_factor_matrix"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

radiosity_patches 面片組中所有面片對的形狀因子 F_ij(遮擋由場景光線判定)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Each pair is form_factor_polygons (n_quad × n_quad Gauss points on the receiver, Lambert's contour sum to the sender) restricted to pairs that face each other; when the patches came from a scene, each Gauss point tests one ray to the sender's centre against the scene. Pairs farther apart than *far_ratio* times the larger patch's diagonal use the receiver's centroid alone (the sender is still exact); far_ratio=None integrates every pair fully. symmetric=True (default) enforces reciprocity exactly by averaging A_i F_ij and A_j F_ji (the raw values agree to the quadrature accuracy) — the progressive solver's F_ij A_i / A_j is then

exactly F_ji.

Candidate pairs use the former, faster all-at-once calculation while its largest temporary fits *memory_budget_mb*, and 256-patch blocks otherwise. The default 256 MB keeps the former path for a 384-patch closed box but blocks 4,096 patches, whose candidate expression alone needs 1.00 GiB. On the 2026-10-21 development machine, whole-call CPU time / tracemalloc peak were 0.234 s / 115 MiB (original), 0.219 s / 60 MiB (default), and 0.234 s / 60 MiB (forced blocks) for 384 patches; the isolated 4,096-patch candidate case measured 0.547 s / 1,152 MiB, 1.500 s / 195 MiB, and 1.516 s / 195 MiB respectively. Pass 0 to always block, or a sufficiently large value to never block.

Returns the (N, N) matrix (matrix), zero diagonal. In a closed enclosure each row sums to 1 (to the quadrature accuracy); an opening shows as a row sum < 1.

Raises ValueError: an empty or unmarked table (not radiosity_patches);

*n_quad* not an integer in [1, 16]; *far_ratio* below 1; or a negative or

non-finite *memory_budget_mb*.

該族通用的輸入契約(fail-closed)

optics 的每個運算子都先檢驗輸入再計算(不讓任何東西無聲通過):

• 單位寫進參數名 —— _mm / _um / _deg / _mrad。把 mm 和 µm 弄混不會當掉,而是給出「看似合理卻是錯的答案」,所以用命名來防。這裡絕不從數值大小去猜單位。

• 字串一律 ValueError —— float('50') 會成功,於是未解析的設定值會被當成長度混進來(實測:thin_lens('50', '200') 曾回傳看似合理的 66.667 mm)。bool 也按 True == 1 的隱式提升拒絕。

• complex / masked array 一律 ValueError(僅接受實數槽位;拒絕無聲丟棄虛部或剝掉遮罩)。所有輸入中的 NaN/Inf 一律 ValueError。

• 逐項點名拒絕除零及其近親:焦距 0、曲率半徑 0、折射率 <= 0、全不透明光闌(全為 0,正規化變成 0/0)、總和 <= 0 的 PSF、S0 = 0 的 Stokes 向量、物體位於前焦點(像在無窮遠)。

• 只有兩個運算子會回傳非有限值,而且都寫進了契約:depth_of_field 在超焦距以外回傳 far_mm = inf(這正是超焦距的定義),gaussian_beam 在束腰處回傳 wavefront_radius_mm = inf(平面波前的曲率半徑)。兩者都同時回傳一個有限的夥伴(far_is_infinite / curvature_per_mm)。除此之外的無聲 NaN/Inf 都在內部檢出並 ValueError ——「float64 溢位了」和「答案是無窮大」是兩種不同的主張,不能拿後者的臉去交付前者。

• 尺寸上限:生成網格受 optics.MAX_GRID(4096)限制,傳入的場/PSF/光闌受 optics.MAX_FIELD_ELEMENTS(2^24),ABCD 元件序列受 optics.MAX_SYSTEM_ELEMENTS(1024),Zernike 受 MAX_ZERNIKE_TERMS(512)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_ORDER(40)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_BASIS(2^25)。以 fail-closed 堵住「小參數引發巨大內部配置」的路徑(實測:n_max=40 × 4096² 需要 108 GB)。

• 物理上不可能的狀態同樣拒絕:偏振度 > 1 的 Stokes 向量、負穿透率、負強度、n-|m| 為奇數等非法 Zernike 指標。
